_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Destin. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md. The Crazy Good Deals page reads this file and merges it with the hand-picked LOCAL_DEALS list inside the page.

deals.name: Baytowne on Ice
deals.deal: Outdoor ice skating - $15 for 90 minutes (+$3 skate rental)
deals.details: Baytowne on Ice seasonal rink, October 30 through February 7, times vary daily. Skaters must be at least 3 and fit appropriately sized skates; under 6 with an adult.

deals.name: Buccaneer Pirate Cruise
deals.deal: Family pirate cruise: children (3-14) $34, adults $40
deals.details: Ages 2 and under $10. 15% local discount with a Florida ID by phone.

deals.name: Crab Island Tours
deals.deal: Shared Crab Island tour: adults $54.99, children $34.99, infants $14.99
deals.details: Discounted non-private ticket prices shown for spring 2027 dates.

deals.name: Destin Helicopter Tour
deals.deal: Aerial tour of Destin, $59 per person
deals.details: Two-passenger minimum, up to four per flight. Private flight option available.

deals.name: Destin History & Fishing Museum
deals.deal: $10 admission, under 2 free; 10% off for military and first responders

deals.name: Destin Vacation Boat Rentals
deals.deal: 10% off food at The Edge Seafood with a Crab Island tour armband
deals.details: No coupon code needed; show your wristband when ordering. Not valid with boat rentals or charters.
deals.location: Destin Harbor · Crab Island · Okaloosa Island

deals.name: Emerald Coast Science Center
deals.deal: Admission $15, under 2 free; $5 per person for up to four with a SNAP EBT card
deals.details: Military and first responders 10% off with active ID.

deals.name: HarborWalk Adventures
deals.deal: Zip line from $34; LED rock wall from $19
deals.details: Combo package deals available. Located at HarborWalk Village.

deals.name: Olin Marler Party Boat Fishing
deals.deal: 4-hour party boat fishing trip, $79 per person (ages 7+)
deals.details: 6 hours $99, 8 hours $129, 10 hours $159. Prices can change by season, day or schedule.

deals.name: Pelican Parasail
deals.deal: Buy one parasailer at regular price, get the second 50% off on 8:30 and 9 AM trips (code PAW50)
deals.details: Book online with coupon code PAW50. Morning trips only.

deals.name: Sandestin Golf
deals.deal: The Links: $89 public, $69 resort guests, Nov 24-Dec 31
deals.details: Fall rate was $119 public / $95 resort. Rates include greens fee, cart and practice balls.

deals.name: Screaming Eagle Dolphin Tours
deals.deal: Speedboat thrill ride from $35; sunset ride from $44
deals.details: One-hour daytime speedboat ride from $35; 1.25-hour sunset ride from $44. Up to 14 passengers.

deals.name: Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruises
deals.deal: Military: $3 off adult tickets with code 3OFF
deals.details: Dolphin cruises from HarborWalk Village, 10 Harbor Blvd.

deals.name: Southern Star Dolphin Cruise
deals.deal: Sunset dolphin cruise $29-$39; daytime cruise $20-$30
deals.details: 1.5-hour cruises from HarborWalk Village. 15% local discount with a Florida ID by phone.

deals.name: The Track Family Fun Park
deals.deal: Point card sale: 250 points $215 (save $35), 125 points $110, 60 points $55
deals.details: Point cards can be used at any of The Track's locations; redeem online orders with a cashier.

deals.name: Urban Air Adventure Park
deals.deal: Small Squad Party Package: party of 5 with Unlimited Play and reserved party space, $224.99
deals.details: Destin park offer, available through February 1, 2027. Table party with a shared host; pre-paid only.

deals.name: Wednesday Night Concert Series - Holiday Edition
deals.deal: Free live music + visits with Santa (Dec 2 & 16)
deals.details: Free Wednesday Night Concert Series, holiday edition, at the Village of Baytowne Wharf with visits with Santa. December 2 and December 16.

deals.name: Wild Willy's Adventure Zone
deals.deal: Point packages with bonus arcade points: $150 gets 150 points + 45 bonus
deals.details: $100 gets 100 points + 25 bonus; $75 gets 75 + 15; $50 gets 50 + 10. Bonus points are for arcade games only.

deals.name: AJ's on the Bayou — Happy Hour
deals.deal: 2-for-1 double talls on draft beer, wine and cocktails, Tue–Fri 3–6 PM. Oysters $15 for a dozen raw or 8 baked.
deals.details: Tuesday to Friday, 3 to 6 PM: $15 dozen raw oysters or 8 baked, 2-for-1 double talls on draft beer, wine and cocktails. Kids eat free Tue-Fri 4-6 PM.

deals.name: AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar
deals.deal: $15 dozen raw oysters, $5 house wines & $5.50 24 oz drafts, Mon-Fri 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3 to 6 PM: $15 dozen raw, baked or steamed oysters, $7 Bimini Bash, $5 house wines, $5 Crown & Down, and $5.50 24 oz drafts. Weekday lunch specials around $12.95.

deals.name: Bitterroot
deals.deal: 30% off all appetizers, $10 house cocktails, $5 beers, $6 house wines, daily 3-6 PM (bar)
deals.details: Bar-only happy hour, 3 to 6 PM. $5 Old Fashioneds on Mondays and $7 cold brew martinis on Tuesdays.

deals.name: Boathouse Oyster Bar
deals.deal: $3 Coors Light and $5 Miller Lite or Michelob, all day
deals.details: Posted everyday beer prices. Raw oysters $14 half dozen, $24 dozen; oysters are dine-in only.

deals.name: Brotula's Seafood House & Steamer
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2-6 PM: half-price house wine, well drinks and select drafts
deals.details: $5 margaritas and $8 select appetizers. Wine Down Wednesday: half-price select wines by the glass, 15% off select bottles, 20% off Captain's List wines.

deals.name: Jester Mardi Gras Daiquiris
deals.deal: 2 for $10 shots
deals.details: Frozen daiquiris and NY-style pizza at HarborWalk Village, 34 Harbor Blvd, Suite 106.

deals.name: Marina Café
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 5-7 PM: half-price wines, martinis, cocktails and domestic beers
deals.details: Specially priced appetizers. Happy hour pricing is not available in the dining room.

deals.name: McGuire's Irish Pub
deals.deal: Half-price draft beer, wine and well drinks, daily 4-6 PM (3-6 PM Fridays)
deals.details: Mon $3 margaritas from 6 PM · Tue $4.99 double-shot martinis all day · Wed Mug Club $2.50 bar drinks and $2 drafts for members · Fri $4 vodka drinks from 6 PM · Sat $3 Bushmills from 6 PM.

deals.name: Mezcal Mexican Grill
deals.deal: Happy hour 2-5 PM daily: $5 menu of margaritas, beer, wine and appetizers
deals.details: Daily happy hour with a $5 menu.

deals.name: Pandora's Steakhouse
deals.deal: Happy hour 5-6:30 PM nightly: 50% off wine by the glass, 35% off cocktails and martinis
deals.details: Daily bar happy hour, 5 to 6:30 PM: 50% off wine by the glass, 35% off cocktails and martinis, 33% off beer and spirits, 25% off frozen drinks and wine bottles.

deals.name: Pompano Joe's
deals.deal: Happy hour 2-4 PM daily: $3.50 drafts, $5 house wine, $7.50 margaritas, $10 appetizers
deals.details: $7.50 PJ's Punch. $10 appetizers include smoked tuna dip, pork nachos, calamari and cheese sticks.

deals.name: Shrimp Basket - Happy Hour
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon-Fri 2-5pm: $3 sips, $6 bites
deals.details: $3 domestic bottles, domestic drafts, house margaritas and house wines. $6 corn fritters, fried pickle chips, onion rings, smoked mahi dip.

deals.name: The Back Porch
deals.deal: Happy hour 3-5 PM daily
deals.details: Destin location happy hour is 3 to 5 PM; the Panama City Beach location runs 2 to 5 PM.

deals.name: The Craft Bar
deals.deal: Tuesday Locals' Night: $5 happy hour drink selection all night
deals.details: Happy hour menu Monday to Friday, 2 to 6 PM. Monday burger night with reduced burger prices; Sunday 11 AM-3 PM, a free glass of Champagne with fried chicken and waffles.

deals.name: The Gulf Club — Draft Wednesday
deals.deal: Buy one, get one free on any of 30 drafts, all day Wednesday
deals.details: Second beer of equal or lesser value. Trivia 6-8 PM.

deals.name: The Wine Bar at Grand Boulevard
deals.deal: A full carafe for the price of a large glass, 11am–6pm daily. Effectively two-for-one wine, seven hours a day.
deals.details: Tuesday Locals' Night: carafe pricing all night, plus prime rib specials. Saturday Steak Night from 5pm. Closed Sundays.

deals.name: AJ's on the Bayou
deals.deal: Weekday lunch plates $12.95, Tuesday shrimp dinner, Wednesday Ladies Night, Thursday prime rib and Sunday brunch.
deals.details: Lunch Tue-Fri 11 AM-4 PM, $12.95 with iced tea. Tuesday fried shrimp and shrimp scampi dinner $19.95 from 4 PM. Wednesday Ladies Night 6-9 PM: two free drinks after the first purchase, $4.50 martinis, $7.50 small plates. Thursday 10 oz prime rib $24.95 from 4 PM until sold out. Kids eat free Tue-Fri 4-6 PM. Sunday brunch 10 AM-3 PM.

deals.name: AJ's Seafood — Weekday Specials
deals.deal: Weekday lunch $12.95 (11 AM-4 PM), Taco Tuesday $4 tacos, Wednesday $12 dozen raw oysters
deals.details: Tuesday all-you-can-eat fried popcorn shrimp $19.95, 4-6 PM. Wednesday $12 dozen raw oysters 3-6 PM this winter. Thursday 10 oz prime rib with baked potato and side salad $24.96, 4-6 PM.

deals.name: Auston's on 98
deals.deal: Buck a Shuck Mon-Fri 3-4 PM: $6 half dozen or $12 dozen raw oysters. Happy hour Mon-Fri 3-5 PM.
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3 to 5 PM: $1.50 off all bar drinks, $5 house margaritas, $5 drink of the week. $3 Bud drafts all day.

deals.name: Cuvée 30A
deals.deal: Happy hour 4-7 PM nightly in the bar: up to 50% off bar menu items.
deals.details: 50% off wine carafes, 33% off beer, 35% off craft cocktails and martinis. Dine-in only; happy hour food orders by 6:30 PM.

deals.name: Louisiana Lagniappe
deals.deal: 2 can dine with a bottle of wine for $59, Sun-Thu
deals.details: Dinner special for a limited time. Opens for dinner daily at 4 PM.

deals.name: Marina Café — Early Dining
deals.deal: Buy one, get one entrée, daily 5-6 PM
deals.details: Some exclusions apply. Early dining is not available in the lounge.

deals.name: Pandora's Steakhouse — Early Dinner BOGO
deals.deal: Buy one, get one prime rib au jus dinner, Sun-Thu 4-5 PM
deals.details: Includes a side and a house salad or French onion soup. Dine-in only; orders by 4:45 PM. Parking validated with purchase.

deals.name: Shrimp Basket
deals.deal: Beach Bites lunch: cheeseburger or grouper slider with soup or salad, $9.99, daily through 5 PM
deals.details: Dine-in or order online. All-you-can-eat specials Sunday to Thursday.

deals.name: The Gulf Club — Weekly Food Specials
deals.deal: Monday half-price wings; Tuesday $10 three-topping small pizza
deals.details: Both run 11 AM to 10 PM. Specialty toppings not included in the pizza special.

deals.name: The Ocean Club
deals.deal: Early dining 2-for-1: buy one entrée, get the second (lower-priced) free, daily 5-6 PM.
deals.details: An odd-numbered guest gets 25% off their entrée. Baked potato is a $5 upcharge.
